verdict.rationale: Parse returns structured JSON with layout and formatting, not flat text. Variable chunking splits at semantic boundaries such as section headers, tables, and figures, so headings are recognized and sections stay together for downstream LLMs. Split can also map named sections to pages. However, no evidence shows an explicit heading hierarchy or a guaranteed reading order in the output. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of heading levels/nesting in parse output, reading-order handling (e.g., multi-column layouts), independent hands-on corroboration of structure preservation.
